status: Frozen as a research candidate for an outcome-blinded evaluation on 2026 labels. Historically it has a lower log loss than v2/v3, but it did not meet the original calibration acceptance criteria. An exploratory protocol, defined after inspecting results, found no clearly failing calibration groups; many groups remain inconclusive. Reliable subgroup calibration, superiority to the G/H1/H2 variants, and operational usefulness have not been established.
scoring_2026: Labels: BDIFF fires >= 0.1 ha, first publication covering all of 2026, commune of first alert, positive commune-day = at least one such fire. Scored as frozen, both departments separately, on 1 Jan - 9 Nov 2026 (retrospective, outcome-blinded) and on later days archived in forecasts/v4/ (live): log loss, ROC AUC, positive commune-days caught by the daily top 15, E/O by season (Nov-Jan, Feb-Mar, Apr-May, Jun-Sep, Oct) with Poisson ranges (a single year cannot be resampled). Compared with v2 (Var), v3, FWI alone and FWI x commune history on the same commune-days. If BDIFF's 2026 records look incomplete (as the Var's 2024), report and do not score that department.
